rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: Risk-off tape driven by an exogenous geopolitical shock: Trump declared the Middle East ceasefire 'over' after fresh US/Iran airstrikes, sending oil soaring and pressuring all risk assets. BTC pulled back to ~$62.3k (-1.7%) from last week's $64k zone. US spot BTC ETFs just snapped a 10-day outflow streak with a +$221.7M haul (largest in 2 months), and Morgan Stanley filed for spot BTC/SOL ETFs — supportive structural demand under a weak tape.
positions.driver: Low-edge, fearful day — the rulebook favors liquid majors with the most downside protection when there is no clean bullish asymmetric setup. BTC is the deepest-liquidity, lowest-beta major, already sold down toward support, giving a definable stop with the tightest 8% band. Runners-up rejected: SOL (-4.6%) is the highest-beta and worst performer today; ETH (-1.8%) still shows net ETF outflows; XRP has the strongest ongoing catalyst (9th straight week of ETF inflows) but is a higher-beta alt in a falling-knife tape and just cost the book a loss. Entry = dashboard live feed (asOf 2026-07-08T11:52:35Z).
positions.risks: Geopolitical headline risk is two-sided and fast — an escalation could crack support and trip the ~8% stop at $57,297.77; MicroStrategy sold 3,588 BTC over the past week, adding corporate supply overhead. Oil-driven inflation fear could keep a bid under the dollar and a lid on crypto. Even majors can gap on weekend/24-7 headlines.
